title: Make room by priority — params
description: When a higher-priority deployment (in target, or any pending one) cannot be placed for lack of VRAM, unload the lowest-priority idle model(s) on the best candidate GPU. always_on is never a victim. Evaluated on demand (placement failure) as well as on the interval.

evict_priorities.title: May evict models with priority
evict_priorities.description: always_on is not allowed here. A victim must also have lower priority than the model that needs room.

victim_idle_minutes.title: Victim must be idle for (minutes)
victim_idle_minutes.description: 0 = may evict a busy model (it is drained first).

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: placement_failure = only when the scheduler reports insufficient VRAM; interval = also scan on every evaluation for pending higher-priority deployments.

protect_always_on.description: Always true; present so the UI shows the guarantee.
